## Epistemic calibration

- [ ] I have not upgraded the framework beyond its supported proof/evidence status.
- [ ] I understand the current status is Stage 4 — candidate proof architecture under named premises, without independent specialist verification and without theorem closure.
- [ ] I have not treated a specialist-handoff document as proof or as evidence that specialist verification has already occurred.
- [ ] If this changes a substantive claim, I identified the relevant premises, dependencies, and falsification consequences.
